facts.fact: NISR published the Rwanda Vital Statistics Report 2024 in April 2025 (figures cover vital events of 2024), generated from the NCI-CRVS civil registration system, with NIDA and the Rwanda Biomedical Centre helping to draft it.
The report calls itself Rwanda's sixth vital statistics report and the annual vital statistics report, a reference for future publications in the same scope; published April 2025 (covers 2024).
